GS39 PRACTICE: Practice now uses the exact same Extra Unit Copy Cost branch as Quick: four normal-cost Troop copies and one normal-cost Other copy. The Practice branch below is derived from the current Quick branch; Standard and Long arithmetic are unchanged.

EXTRA UNIT COPY COSTS / GS37. Permanent required accounting entry. Troop and Other arithmetic remain logically separate but live directly on this single visible parent. Hormagaunts (10), normal Termagants (10), and Gargoyles (10) remain the three independent Troop copy families. Living Incubator broods remain distinct zero-point generated unit IDs and do not consume the normal Termagant allowance. Twelve native non-Rare Other families retain their established accounting; Neurolictor remains Rare and excluded. Practice / Quick / Standard / Long normal-copy allowances are 3 / 4 / 6 / 8 for Troops and 0 / 1 / 2 / 3 for Other. Each excess identical copy adds 20 Points.

rules.name: Patch Notes
rules.description:
## Tyranids 3.3.4

*Full patch notes and rules can be found in the Reforged Discord Server: https://discord.gg/BpjkaNmMVB*

## Changelog (September 23rd)

• Presentation: standardized ◆ unit markers to the project-wide two-space format in roster exports.
• 420 Point Practice: now uses 0 Leader Points and Quick-equivalent Extra Unit Copy Cost allowances; LP-costing units are hidden unless already selected.

## Changelog (September 21st)

• Standardized Configuration ordering across the listbuilder.
• Presentation: standardized ◆ unit presentation; cleaned Additional Model labels for Ripper Swarms, Hive Guard, and Tyrant Guard.

## Changelog (September 19th)

• Presentation: adopted the current emoji-enabled listbuilder presentation, including LP ⭐, 🏷️ Unit Abilities, 🧰 Loadout Options, and shared category icons.
• Unit Abilities: added all top-level Unit Ability names across the army.
• Added 420 Point Practice support across Leader Points, Living Incubator, and Extra Unit Copy Costs; Living Incubator grants no free broods in Practice.
• Neurothrope - Leech Essence and Trygon Prime - Synapse now appear only with their matching upgrades.

## Changelog (September 17th)

• Added source model-count suffixes across Tyranid multi-model units.
• Hive Tyrant, Tervigon, and Neurotyrant now spend all Leader Points granted by Game Size; Warrior remains 0 LP.
• Standardized checkbox controls for Ripper Swarm extra models, Attached Warrior, Hive/Tyrant Guard extra models, and Zoanthrope/Trygon upgrades.
• Hive Guard loadouts now use atomic cannon & Powerful Limbs packages; added the Frenzied Feeders Ripper Swarm model counter.

catalogue.comment:
REV50 / GS40 — CHANGELOG ROLLOVER CONSOLIDATION
Applied the one-day Changelog rollover rule retroactively: the September 24th player-facing Changelog section was folded into September 23rd, with the September 24 entries moved to the top of that section in their existing order. The `Updated: September 24th` Configuration marker remains unchanged because it records the actual artifact update date. No IDs, targets, points, LP, constraints, modifiers, associations, loadouts, categories, copy-cost arithmetic, Practice behavior, Unit Ability ownership, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV49 / GS40 — GLOBAL CHANGELOG STANDARDIZATION
Standardized the shared September 19/21/23/24 player-facing Changelog events across the live faction set: emoji-enabled presentation, complete top-level Unit Ability-name presentation, Configuration ordering, 420 Point Practice 0-LP/Quick-equivalent behavior, and the project-wide two-space ◆ export format. Faction-specific Changelog bullets and historical implementation details were preserved. No executable list-construction mechanics changed.

REV48 / GS40 — CURRENT-STATE DOCUMENTATION REFRESH
Corrected only the present-tense CURRENT STATE documentation to the live GS40 state. Practice copy allowances now reflect the GS39+ Quick-equivalent 4 Troop / 1 Other baseline where the stale GS37 text still described 3 / 0. The Tyranid all-Leader-Points apex-Leader summary now reflects 0-LP Practice and 2 / 3 / 4 LP at Quick / Standard / Long. Historical revision notes and separate shared-library/version references remain unchanged for their own audit passes. No IDs, targets, costs, LP objects or modifiers, constraints, associations, loadouts, category ownership, copy-cost arithmetic, Practice hiding logic, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV47 / GS40 — CHANGELOG CLEANUP
Renamed the player-facing maintenance history to Changelog, kept dated sections newest-first, and consolidated overlapping entries while preserving what changed and which units/systems were affected. Detailed implementation history remains in this catalogue comment. No IDs, targets, costs, LP, constraints, modifiers, associations, loadouts, categories, copy-cost arithmetic, generated-unit behavior, counters, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV46 / GS40 — DIAMOND EXPORT SPACING
Added exactly one additional literal space after every diamond unit-marker character in catalogue-owned strings. Unit names and childName mirrors therefore remain synchronized. No IDs, targets, costs, LP, constraints, modifiers, associations, loadouts, category ownership, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV45 / GS40 — PRACTICE DESCRIPTION CLEANUP COMPATIBILITY
Retargeted to Game System revision 40 after removal of redundant construction-summary text from the 420 Point Practice description. No catalogue-local executable data changed in this revision: Practice LP visibility, explicit 0-LP attachment-only exceptions where present, Extra Unit Copy Cost arithmetic, points, IDs, loadouts, associations, and all unit mechanics remain unchanged.

REV44 / GS39 — PRACTICE ZERO-LP MIGRATION
This component now targets Game System revision 39. Every locally owned unit root carrying a positive LP cost receives selected-safe Practice hiding: it is hidden while 420 Point Practice is active only when that unit is not already selected. Explicit 0-LP roots do not exist under the project convention, so no exception tags are required. The local Extra Unit Copy Costs Practice branch is now an exact clone of the current Quick branch, giving Practice four normal-cost Troop copies and one normal-cost Other copy. Points, intrinsic LP costs, IDs, loadouts, associations, category ownership, Quick/Standard/Long arithmetic, and unrelated mechanics are unchanged.

CURRENT SYSTEM-WIDE CONFIGURATION ORDER / GS38
This catalogue now targets Game System revision 38. Configuration presentation follows the shared lane doctrine: provenance warning 5 when applicable; Game Size 10; army identity 20; optional army structure 30; Leader Points 40; faction trackers 50; Extra Unit Copy Costs 80; Updated 90; About 100. Only locally-owned applicable lanes are stored in this file; Game Size, Leader Points, and About are supplied by the Game System. No unit IDs, costs, constraints, modifiers, attachment topology, loadout legality, or copy-cost arithmetic were changed by this pass.

CURRENT STATE — TYRANIDS 3.3.4 / GS40
Tyranids 3.3.4 targets Game System revision 40 and uses the current Leader Points, Practice, Extra Unit Copy Costs, Unit Abilities, and presentation infrastructure. Twenty-one native root units, the shared Warrior and Neuroloids units, and the three Living Incubator Termagant brood structures retain their stable IDs, points, loadouts, attachment topology, generated-unit semantics, Rare handling, counters, and validation unless explicitly listed in the September 19th Changelog section.

Hive Tyrant, Tervigon, and Neurotyrant each cost all Leader Points granted by Game Size at Quick / Standard / Long: 2 / 3 / 4 LP respectively. In 420 Point Practice, the Game Size grants 0 LP, so these LP-costing apex Leaders are unavailable unless already selected under the catalogue's selected-safe Practice hiding. They still share the independent pooled max-one HIVE TYRANT / TERVIGON / NEUROTYRANT restriction. Hive Tyrant alone carries the  command marker. Warrior remains a Countless 0-LP Leader with no LP cost object.

Living Incubator generates 0 / 1 / 2 / 3 zero-point nested Termagant broods at Practice / Quick / Standard / Long. These generated broods use distinct stable unit IDs, preserve normal Termagant loadout grammar at zero cost, may include the shared Warrior, and remain deliberately absent from normal Termagant Extra Unit Copy Cost accounting. Neurotyrant retains mandatory nested Neuroloids. Frenzied Feeders remains informational only and creates no Ripper unit.

Extra Unit Copy Costs uses one visible accounting entry. Hormagaunts (10), normal Termagants (10), and Gargoyles (10) remain the three Troop copy families; twelve non-Rare Other families retain their established accounting; Neurolictor remains Rare and excluded. Practice / Quick / Standard / Long normal-copy allowances are 4 / 4 / 6 / 8 for Troops and 1 / 1 / 2 / 3 for Other.

AUTHORING / PRESENTATION NOTES
Unit rows use ◆ ; 🧰 marks Loadout Options; immediate model-role headers use the Tyranids 🧬 marker; attachment relationship labels use 🔗; and Infantry, Vehicle, Monster, and Rare category labels use current Game System presentation. Ripper Swarms retain two independent +20 Point Additional Ripper Swarm Model checkboxes with no sequence or model-number meaning. Hive Guard and Tyrant Guard retain their direct max-one Additional Model checkboxes. Top-level Unit Ability names are represented as shared Profiles for all actual Tyranid unit structures, including the generated Living Incubator broods; nested sub-abilities are intentionally omitted.

OPTIONAL UNIT ABILITY PRESENTATION: top-level abilities granted by selectable upgrades are linked to the upgrade rather than the unit root, so New Recruit displays them only when that option is selected. Neurothrope - Leech Essence is linked to the Zoanthrope upgrade, and Synapse is linked to Trygon Prime - Synapse.

HISTORICAL SOURCE COMMENT FROM REV40
CURRENT STATE — TYRANIDS 3.3.4 / GS26
Tyranids 3.3.4 uses the mature final-state companion-listbuilder grammar. Native Troops Hormagaunts (10), Termagants (10), and Gargoyles (10) use the 4 / 6 / 8 Additional Copy Cost allowance; 12 non-Rare Other families use the 1 / 2 / 3 allowance. Neurolictor is Rare and excluded from soft-copy accounting.

CURRENT FACTION ARCHITECTURE
- Hive Tyrant, Tervigon, and Neurotyrant each cost all Leader Points granted by Game Size (2 / 3 / 4 LP at 800 / 1200 / 1600) and independently share one pooled army-list maximum. The pooled max-one restriction remains a separate legality axis from LP.
- Living Incubator is implemented as 1 / 2 / 3 zero-point nested Termagant brood units at 800 / 1200 / 1600 Points. These generated broods use distinct unit IDs, preserve the normal Termagant loadout grammar at zero cost, may include one nested shared Warrior, and deliberately do not consume normal Termagant Additional Copy Cost allowance.
- Warrior is a shared full Countless Leader unit exposed through checkbox-style Attached Warrior entryLinks on eligible Hormagaunt and Termagant hosts, including Living Incubator broods. It costs 0 leader points and therefore has no LP cost object.
- Neurotyrant includes mandatory nested Neuroloids.
- Frenzied Feeders is an informational roster counter driven by a hidden semantic category. It reports Ripper Swarm Size but creates no battlefield Ripper Swarm unit.
- Ripper Swarms use a four-model 80 Point root plus two independent +20 Point checkbox slots, both named Additional Ripper Swarm Model. The slots are interchangeable and have no sequencing or model-number meaning. The fixed core exports through the shared 4x Ripping Jaws package.
- Hive Guard 3 and Tyrant Guard 3 use direct checkbox-style Additional Model selections. Zoanthrope and Trygon optional upgrades use direct Unit Upgrade checkboxes.

AUTHORING / RUNTIME NOTES
- Rules descriptions sourced from the authoritative rules PDF are verbatim source text and are not editorialized by catalogue maintenance.
- Living Incubator broods are generated units, not normal Termagant copies. Keep their IDs out of the normal Troop copy-cost ledger.
- Attached Warrior is a nested full-unit relationship. Keep the relationship section, but max-1 belongs on the Warrior entryLink so New Recruit renders a checkbox.
- The Ripper Swarm base package intentionally separates concise editor labels from the canonical 4x Ripping Jaws export target.

PRE-REV11 HISTORICAL IMPLEMENTATION NOTES — SUPERSEDED
Early Tyranid builds passed through several now-obsolete prototypes: Ripper Swarms briefly used quantity-style additional-model controls before returning to explicit models; Living Incubator was first modelled through external Termagant associations, then dynamic association counts and a distinct-brood picker, before becoming the current automatically generated nested-brood implementation. Those experiments are retained here only as history and are not current authoring instructions. The nested shared Warrior architecture survived that migration and became production behavior.

REV11 — CONSTRUCTIVE VALIDATION MIGRATION
Moved Rare and pooled Leader restrictions to constructive player-facing validation and finalized selected-safe Living Incubator brood handling. Nested Warrior architecture remained intact.

REV13 — NEW RECRUIT EXPORT COMPATIBILITY
Moved all Points references to canonical cost type 51b2-306e-1021-d207 without changing rules semantics.

REV20 — RETROSPECTIVE POLISH PASS
Standardized model headers, Attached Neuroloids naming, Additional Model labels, and '&' package grammar while preserving IDs and mechanics.

REV21 / GS17 — TROOP COPY COSTS
Added unified Troops / Other Additional Copy Costs. Normal Hormagaunts, Termagants, and Gargoyles use 4 / 6 / 8; Living Incubator broods remain exempt by distinct generated IDs.

REV22 — NEUROLICTOR RARE + WARRIOR EXPORT CLEANUP
Corrected Neurolictor to Rare and removed it from Other soft-copy accounting. Cleaned Warrior Brood export wording while preserving IDs.

REV23 — RIPPER SWARM EXPORT QUANTITY FIX
Introduced the canonical 4x Ripping Jaws shared export package for the fixed four-model core.

REV24 — NEUROTYRANT SECTION ORDER
Moved Loadout Options above Attached Neuroloids.

REV25 — GS20 TROOP COPY RULE
Retargeted native Troops to the short-form Additional Copy Cost - Troop rule.

REV26 — TYRANIDS 3.3.4 + STANDARD PATCH NOTES
Updated the rules baseline to Tyranids 3.3.4 and added the automatically present Patch Notes Configuration.

REV27 — GAME SYSTEM 21 SYNC
Retargeted the catalogue to Game System revision 21 without semantic changes.

REV28 — FRENZIED FEEDERS COUNTER
Added the roster-derived Ripper Swarm Size informational counter.

REV29 — HIVE GUARD ATOMIC LOADOUTS
Consolidated Hive Guard weapons into atomic final-state packages.

REV30 — CHANGELOG BASELINE
Rebuilt the player-facing Changelog section and established the retained maintenance baseline. Later workflow treats this list as cumulative from that baseline onward.

REV31 — UNIT UPGRADE CHECKBOXES
Converted Neurothrope - Leech Essence and Trygon Prime - Synapse to direct Unit Upgrade checkboxes.

REV32 — ADDITIONAL MODEL CHECKBOXES
Converted Hive Guard 3 and Tyrant Guard 3 to direct Additional Model checkboxes.

REV33 — NESTED / VARIABLE-SIZE CLEANUP
Converted all five Attached Warrior relationships to checkbox-style entryLinks. Consolidated the two interchangeable Ripper Swarm optional models under one Additional Models section, renamed both selections Additional Ripper Swarm Model, and moved their max-1 constraints onto the model entries for checkbox rendering. Updated the cumulative Changelog heading to September 12th and consolidated stale/conflicting comments into current-state, durable authoring, and clearly historical sections.

REV34 — GS23 SYNC
Retargeted the catalogue from Game System revision 21 to revision 23 as a compatibility-only metadata sync.

REV35 — LEADER POINTS MIGRATION
- Retargeted catalogue from GS23 to GS24.
- Hive Tyrant, Tervigon, and Neurotyrant now carry intrinsic LP costs representing the source rule "This unit costs all your leader points.": 2 LP at 800, 3 LP at 1200, 4 LP at 1600.
- Warrior remains Countless with no LP cost object; its existing source-derived rule object now uses the official 3.3.4 wording "This unit costs 0 leader points." and keeps the same rule ID.
- The three apex Leaders intentionally remain absent from Counts Toward Leader Maximum because that was the pre-migration Tyranid architecture; their independent pooled max-one restriction and Rare semantics remain unchanged.
- No Points, loadouts, generated Living Incubator broods, attachment topology, Additional Copy Cost arithmetic, or other faction mechanics changed.

REV36 — LEADER POINTS CLEANUP
Runtime validation passed for the Tyranids Leader Points implementation. Hive Tyrant, Tervigon, and Neurotyrant retain their all-Leader-Points behavior, with LP set dynamically to 2 / 3 / 4 at 800 / 1200 / 1600 Points. Warrior remains a source-defined 0-LP Leader with no LP cost object. Tyranids intentionally had no catalogue-side Counts Toward Leader Maximum links, so no legacy mechanical IDs were removed in this cleanup. The independent Hive Tyrant / Tervigon / Neurotyrant pooled max-one restriction, attachment rules, Living Incubator logic, points, loadouts, Additional Copy Costs, and all unrelated Tyranids mechanics remain unchanged. Patch Notes presentation was updated to the September 14th cleanup convention.
